title: Audio and video
summary: Embed sound and video with audio, video and source, and give the browser a fallback.

options: Shows play, pause and volume buttons
quiz.explain: `controls` gives the visitor the built-in player buttons.

quiz.q: Complete the media type of this source.
quiz.explain: The `type` attribute tells the browser the format so it can skip files it cannot play.

quiz.q: Where does the fallback text go?
options: Inside the audio or video element, after the source elements
quiz.explain: Text between the tags is shown only by a browser that does not support the element at all, so it works as a safety net.

quiz.q: Click the line that makes this audio player unusable.
quiz.code:
<audio>
  <source src="talk.mp3" type="audio/mpeg">
  Your browser does not support audio.
</audio>
quiz.explain: There is no `controls` attribute, so the visitor sees no player and cannot start the sound.

exercise.task:
Add media to `index.html`.

- An `<audio>` with `controls` and a `<source>` whose `src` is `media/talk.mp3` and `type` is `audio/mpeg`.
- A `<video>` with `controls`, a `width`, and a `poster` attribute.
- Inside the video, a `<source>` with `src` `media/intro.mp4` and `type` `video/mp4`.
- Fallback text inside both the audio and the video element.
hints: Add the audio first. controls is written alone, with no value.
Each source needs src and type. Put the fallback sentence after the source, still inside the element.

<audio controls>
  <source src="media/talk.mp3" type="audio/mpeg">
  Your browser does not support audio.
</audio>
<video controls width="480" poster="images/intro.jpg">
  <source src="media/intro.mp4" type="video/mp4">
  Your browser does not support video.
</video>

checks.name: The audio source type is audio/mpeg
The audio has fallback text
checks.hint: Write a sentence inside <audio> after the source.

checks.name: The video has width and poster attributes
The video source is media/intro.mp4 of type video/mp4
The video has fallback text
checks.hint: Write a sentence inside <video> after the source.
